research_notes: Blocked: primary sources substantiate a fourteen-year public-service career, but individual employment hours, breaks and exact transfer/cessation dates remain unverified after official and conference biography searches plus first speech.
Fourteen years is a self-reported career duration, not a verified full-time headline. Contiguous year labels must be merged with proper boundaries if future evidence establishes FTE.
No private employment is documented in these sources; this is unknown rather than zero. Overseas company directors, researchers and sportspeople of the same name were not used.

These refine portfolio succession inside the official2007–2013 DPCD spell but do not establish exact transfer boundaries, substantive full-time status, leave or2016 cessation.
